title: Page 7
content_zh:
但现在他却将她狠狠的往外推，只因他承受不起，他胆小，深怕有一天会从她的眼中看到她对自己的鄙视跟厌恶，他或许不是精神病患，但他真的因为绑架阴影有着懦弱、不堪一击的一面，他不希望他喜欢的女人看到这样的自己。

赵霖在车上想了好久好久，望向搁在副驾驶座上的牛皮纸袋，下定决心，拿出手机拨出电话……

第10章(1)

终于接到赵霖的电话，白薇秀无法欺骗自己，她的心确实小小雀跃了一下，而且他说他此时人就在楼下，要她下楼，所以她结束通话后，随便找了个理由，跟许安安说想去便利商店买点东西。

许安安岂会不懂，装作不知情，挥挥手要她快去。

白薇秀因为太过兴奋，压根没有多想为什么赵霖会知道她离家之后住在许安安家里，来到楼下，看到他的车，她很自动的

一股沐浴后的淡雅清香扑鼻而来，赵霖得花好大的力气才能将乱了序的心压制住，同时不断告诉自己，只要给出约，让她看过之后无异议签名，再叫她明天到律师事务所拿两千万的现金支票即可。

过程中无需要赘言，态度要坚持，至于个人的情感……既然他曾压抑过一次，那么这一次也不是什么大问题。

白薇秀直觉认为他应该是来道歉的，便静静等着他开口，心想着只要他有诚意，她一定会原谅他的。

没办法，就像许安安说的，女人吃亏在爱情至上。

在第一个晚上离家出走逃靠到许安安家里，她发火恼怒不停的数落赵霖，可是许安安的一句话就让她的怒火戛然而止——

“你如果不在乎，就不会在我面前不停的数落赵霖，然后把自己气得像只炸虾一样，你现在这个样子，在我看来，根本就是在放闪，如果不喜欢、不爱一个人，是绝对不会为他多花心思的。”

旁观者清，说的正是许安安，他身为同性恋，感情路走得比一般人坎坷，但也丰富，他为追求真爱不屈不挠，所以他评论爱情总是一针见血，直接到让人无力反驳。

她喜欢上赵霖了？！深夜躺在床上，白薇秀难以入眠，一直想着这个问题。

他们不是只是合约关系的婚姻吗？从什么时候开始她习惯总是多准备一份他的便当，还会花时间思索菜色，就担心他吃不习惯、吃不健康；她喜欢他周末留在家里不要外出应酬跟加班；喜欢他在她出门要去附近传统菜市场买菜时忽地跟上，说反正他待在家也满闲的，当苦力帮忙提菜当锻炼身体；喜欢他们在一起品酒、喝咖啡时，慷慨激昂争论，或是兴致高昂的讨论共同话题；喜欢看老电影看到体力不支睡着，醒来后发现自己躺在他的床上……

他们在床上也同样的契合，他总是喜欢逗她，却也会爱怜的亲吻她，有好几次他们甚至相拥而眠到天亮，醒来后却没有任何尴尬，他们就像一对真正且恩爱的夫妻，只是她身在其中却未曾发觉。

她心疼他幼时惨痛的遭遇，那是打从心里的为他痛，而不是同情，如果只是同情的话，她根本不会有想冲到吴佩茹面前撕烂她那张伪善脸孔的冲动；如果只是同情的话，在他说出她爱钱、就算违约也会照付钱那些话时，她不会气到脑袋都快冒烟了。

套句许安安说的，若不在乎就不会有那么多情绪，没必要的。

只是现在她跟他之间有些尴尬，该怎么做或说些什么才能化解？还有，他又是怎么看待她的呢？现在他亲自来找她了，是不是表示他对她的感情也不一般？

白薇秀越想，心头不禁泛满期待，带着情意的目光瞅向他。

但赵霖却一脸冷凝严肃，想起她亲密挽着许安安手臂的画面，满坑满谷的醋意都快要把他溺毙了，他沉声道：“我把合约带来了，你看过若是没问题，就赶紧签一签，签完就可以找我的律师支领尾款，跟你真正的恋人双宿双飞了。”

她花了好几秒的时间，才理解他的话，他是怕她到律师那里耍赖不签字吗？！而且什么叫做跟她真正的恋人双宿双飞？她哪来的恋人，天上掉下来的吗？

赵霖将牛皮纸袋递给她，她脑袋一片空白的接过，拿出合约摊开，却一个字都看不进去，只觉得心像是被人用双手紧紧掐住一般，疼痛无比，就连呼吸也越发困难。

看着看着，眼睛竟然起了雾，鼻头一酸想哭了，但她不能哭，哭了岂不是成为笑话，爱上一个本来以为不可能会爱的男人，真的好蠢。

她用力眨了眨眼，强逼自己把泪水给眨回去。

合约内容写些什么她看不清楚，更不想看清楚，原来都是她想太多了，以为赵霖跟她一样，经过几个月的同居生活，喜欢有彼此的陪伴，也爱上了对方……并没有！对他而言，任何女人都可以取代她。

思及此，心酸跟鼻酸瞬间涌上，泪水差点又不争气的掉下来。

她真的好想问问他，为什么要如此对待她，可是她不能，他并没有做错什么，一切都照着合约走，他的心没有沦陷，是他够有自制力。

可是，她觉得心好痛、好痛，她觉得车子里头的空气变得越来越稀薄，她想要深呼吸，可因为忍着哭意，深呼吸变得断断续续。

赵霖终于察觉她的不对劲，觉得她低头看合约也看得太久了。好吧，他希望她可以看久一点，这么一来他就可以贪婪的再多看她几眼。

白薇秀再也忍不住了，一滴心痛的泪水啪的一声落到合约上头。

车内的氛围安静又紧绷，泪水落下的声音赵霖听到了，也看到了，泪珠在纸上晕开了，渲染成圈。

“你哭了？”他愣了一秒，嗓音沙哑的问。

白薇秀迅速用手背抹去更多不听话的泪水，抬起头来，一脸倔强的道：“怎么，合约上有规定不能哭吗？还是在你车上不能哭？”都被发现偷哭了，就牙尖嘴利的轰回去吧，反正之后也不会再见面了。“我就是要哭，很用力很大声的哭，哭哭哭，怎样！”她将下巴抬得高高的，还想保留最后一点自尊，但说出口的话却幼稚得像个孩子，而且她当真说到做到，哭得更凶了。

“你、你别哭了。”赵霖不是没看过别的女人在他面前落泪，但她们都不是白薇秀，杀伤力没那么惊人。

白薇秀误以为他觉得她哭很烦人，心一拧，哭得更大声了，既然他不许她哭，她就偏要哭，哭到他心烦意乱，当做报复好了。

“我偏要哭，就是要哭，不然你把违约金额加到五千万好了，加到五千万我就不哭了。”她这不经大脑脱口而出的话，无疑是来找碴添乱的。

他的确被她的泪水搞得心烦意乱，心揪成一团，一生的英明睿智在此时都派不上用场，只能好言附和，“好、好、好，我加到五千万，你别哭了。”

白薇秀一听，不但没有马上不哭，而是哭得更大声更伤心更无法控制。

赵霖紧紧蹙起了眉，他哪知道女人最爱说反话，更没想到会弄巧成拙。

她心忖，她不过是随口说说，他却答应了，难道在他心中，她就是一个死要钱的女人，甚至是个只要用钱就可以打发的贪婪女人？！

白薇秀一个恼火，将手中的合约往赵霖身上砸去。“钱钱钱，用钱可以买到真心吗？跟真心比起来，五千万只能买到一个屁！”
content_en:
But now he is pushing her away hard because he can't bear it. He is timid and afraid that one day he will see her contempt and disgust for him in her eyes. He may not be a mental patient, but he really has a cowardly and vulnerable side because of the shadow of kidnapping. He doesn't want the woman he likes to see him like this.

Zhao Lin thought for a long time in the car, looked at the brown paper bag placed on the passenger seat, made up his mind, took out his mobile phone and made a call...

Chapter 10(1)

When she finally received a call from Zhao Lin, Bai Weixiu couldn't deceive herself. Her heart did jump a little, and he said that he was downstairs at this time and wanted her to go downstairs. So after she ended the call, she found a reason and told Xu Anan that she wanted to buy something at a convenience store.

How could Xu Anan not understand? He pretended not to know and waved her hand to go quickly.

Bai Weixiu was so excited that she didn't think much about why Zhao Lin knew that she was living in Xu Anan's house after leaving home. When she came downstairs and saw his car, she automatically

A light and refreshing fragrance after bathing hit his nostrils, and Zhao Lin had to exert a lot of effort to suppress his disordered heart. At the same time, he kept telling himself that as long as he made an appointment, let her sign it without objection after reading it, and then ask her to go to the law firm tomorrow to get a cash check of 20 million.

There is no need to go into details during the process, and the attitude must be persistent. As for personal emotions... Since he suppressed them once, it is not a big problem this time.

Bai Weixiu intuitively thought that he should come to apologize, so she waited quietly for him to speak, thinking that as long as he was sincere, she would definitely forgive him.

There is no way, as Xu Anan said, women suffer because love comes first.

On the first night she ran away from home and fled to Xu Anan's house, she got angry and kept scolding Zhao Lin, but Xu Anan's words stopped her anger abruptly——

"If you didn't care, you wouldn't keep scolding Zhao Lin in front of me, and then make yourself as angry as a fried shrimp. In my opinion, you are just showing off. If you don't like or love someone, you will never pay more attention to him."

It is clear to onlookers that the person he is talking about is Xu Anan. As a homosexual, his emotional journey is more bumpy than ordinary people, but it is also rich. He is unyielding in the pursuit of true love, so his comments on love are always to the point, so direct that no one can refute it.

Does she like Zhao Lin?!Lying in bed late at night, Bai Weixiu couldn't sleep and kept thinking about this problem.

Aren't they just a contractual marriage?Since when did she get used to always preparing an extra lunch for him and spending time thinking about the dishes, she was worried that he was not used to eating and eating unhealthy? She liked that he stayed at home on weekends and did not go out to socialize or work overtime; she liked that he would suddenly follow her when she went out to buy vegetables at the nearby traditional vegetable market,He said that he had plenty of time to stay at home anyway, working as a coolie to help carry vegetables and exercising; he liked them to have impassioned arguments or discuss common topics with high spirits when they were tasting wine or drinking coffee together; he liked to watch old movies and fell asleep when he was exhausted, and when he woke up, he found himself lying on his bed...

They were equally compatible in bed. He always liked to tease her, but he would also kiss her lovingly. Several times they even slept with each other until dawn, but there was no embarrassment when they woke up. They were like a real and loving couple, but she didn't realize it when they were together.

She felt sorry for his tragic childhood experience. She felt pain for him from the bottom of her heart, not sympathy. If it was just sympathy, she would not have the urge to rush in front of Wu Peiru and tear her hypocritical face to pieces; if it was just sympathy, when he said that she loved money and would pay even if she broke the contract, she would not be so angry that her head was about to smoke.

To paraphrase what Xu Anan said, if you don't care, you won't have so many emotions, it's unnecessary.

It's just that there is some embarrassment between her and him now. What should she do or say to resolve it?Also, what does he think of her?Now that he has come to see her in person, does it mean that his feelings for her are not ordinary?

The more Bai Weixiu thought about it, her heart couldn't help but be filled with expectation, and she looked at him with affectionate eyes.

But Zhao Lin had a cold and serious look on his face. Thinking of the scene of her holding Xu Anan's arm intimately, he was almost drowned in jealousy. He said in a deep voice: "I brought the contract. If you read it and it's okay, just sign it quickly. After signing, you can go to my lawyer to collect the balance, and you can stay and fly with your real lover."

It took her several seconds to understand what he said. Was he afraid that she would go to the lawyer and cheat and not sign?!And what does it mean to stay and fly together with her real lover?Where did her lover come from? Did he fall from the sky?

Zhao Lin handed her the brown paper bag, and she took it with a blank mind. She took out the contract and spread it out, but she couldn't read a word. She just felt that her heart was pinched tightly with both hands. The pain was extremely painful, and even breathing became more and more difficult.

As she watched, her eyes became misty, her nose felt sour and she wanted to cry, but she couldn't cry. Wouldn't it become a joke if she cried? It was really stupid to fall in love with a man whom she thought was impossible to love.

She blinked hard, forcing herself to blink back the tears.

She couldn't see clearly what was written in the contract, and she didn't want to see it clearly. It turned out that she was overthinking it, thinking that Zhao Lin was like her. After several months of living together, she liked each other's company and fell in love with each other... No!To him, any woman could take her place.

Thinking of this, my heart and nose suddenly surged up, and my tears almost fell down again.

She really wanted to ask him why he treated her like this, but she couldn't. He didn't do anything wrong. Everything was in accordance with the contract. His heart didn't fall. It was because he had enough self-control.

However, her heart ached so much. She felt that the air in the car was getting thinner and thinner. She wanted to take a deep breath, but because she was holding back her tears, her deep breaths became intermittent.

Zhao Lin finally noticed something was wrong with her and felt that she had been looking down at the contract for too long.Well, he hoped she could look at her longer, so that he could look at her greedily a few more times.

Bai Weixiu couldn't bear it anymore, and a tear of heartache fell on the contract.

The atmosphere in the car was quiet and tense. Zhao Lin heard and saw the sound of tears falling. The tears spread on the paper and formed circles.

"Are you crying?" He was stunned for a second and asked in a hoarse voice.

Bai Weixiu quickly wiped away more disobedient tears with the back of her hand, raised her head, and said with a stubborn look on her face: "What, is there a stipulation in the contract that you can't cry? Or is it that you can't cry in your car?" If they were caught secretly crying, just yell back with a sharp tongue. Anyway, we won't see each other again."I just want to cry, cry very hard and loud, cry, cry, cry, how about it!" She raised her chin high, trying to retain her last bit of self-esteem, but the words she spoke were as childish as a child's, and she meant what she said, so she cried harder.

"You, please stop crying." It's not like Zhao Lin has never seen other women cry in front of him, but they are not Bai Weixiu, and their lethality is not that amazing.

Bai Weixiu mistakenly thought that he found her crying annoying, so she felt her heart twisting and cried louder. Since he didn't allow her to cry, she insisted on crying until he was upset, so she took it as revenge.

"I want to cry, I just want to cry, otherwise you can increase the default amount to 50 million. If you increase the amount to 50 million, I won't cry." What she blurted out without thinking was undoubtedly to cause trouble.

He was indeed upset by her tears, and his heart was twisted into a ball. All his wisdom and wisdom in his life were of no use at this moment, so he could only agree, "Okay, okay, okay, I'll increase it to 50 million, so don't cry."

When Bai Weixiu heard this, not only did she not stop crying immediately, but she cried louder, sadder and uncontrollably.

Zhao Lin frowned tightly. He didn't know that women love to talk sarcastically, and he didn't expect that it would be self-defeating.

She thought to herself that she was just talking casually, but he agreed. Could it be that in his mind, she was a woman who desperately wanted money, or even a greedy woman who could be spent with money?!

Bai Weixiu was annoyed and threw the contract in her hand at Zhao Lin."Money, money, money, can you buy sincerity with money? Compared with sincerity, fifty million can only buy you nothing!"
